align.summary: Stack alignment passed to setAlign; this is an engine-facing value, not text alignment.

animationMode.summary: Control window show/hide animation; off disables both directions.

animationPaused.summary: Reserved no-op in this revision; it does not pause an animation.

base.summary: Reserved no-op in AttributeParser; do not expect a visible effect from this setter.

condition.summary: Construction-time condition evaluated by readSkin for supported config/BoxInfo expressions, not a live visibility binding.

conditional.summary: Include an element when at least one named component exists in the screen; processed by readSkin.

connection.summary: Names the component connections for a GUI addon; readSkin consumes this before attribute application.

excludes.summary: Skip an element when any listed component exists; processed while building the screen.

flags.summary: Comma-separated eWindow flags, for example wfNoBorder; belongs on a screen/window.

ignoreWidgets.summary: Screen metadata for optional widgets; the AttributeParser handler itself is a no-op.

includes.summary: Include an element when any listed component exists; the counterpart of excludes.

label.summary: Reserved metadata/no-op in AttributeParser; no label is created by this attribute alone.

layout.summary: Select panel/stack layout in the structure parser; this setter itself is a no-op.

position.summary: x,y relative to the current layout context; centre and arithmetic coordinates are supported.

resolution.summary: The design coordinate system width,height; readSkin derives scaling from the desktop.

size.summary: width,height of the widget; does not set its text alignment or font size.

spacing.summary: Spacing setter for supporting native widgets; a panel also consumes spacing for its layout context.

spacingColor.summary: Colour of spacing in a native widget that supports setSpacingColor.

stack.summary: Reserved structural metadata; the AttributeParser handler itself performs no action.

tag.summary: Integer widget identifier used by native stack/layout machinery.

title.summary: Window title; translated with the current interface locale before being applied.

zPosition.summary: Integer painting layer among overlapping widgets; larger values are in front.

font.summary: Registered font face or alias and size, for example Regular;28. It is not a font file path.

fontScale.summary: Automatic label font adjustment: size;offset or width;offset (default offset -4).

foregroundColor.summary: Text/foreground colour. A gradient value is supported only by the slider foreground path.

horizontalAlignment.summary: Text alignment inside its rectangle: left, center, right or block.

noWrap.summary: Legacy wrap alias; prefer wrap="noWrap" or wrap="wrap".

padding.summary: One, two or four comma-separated inset values: left,top,right,bottom. Two values repeat as x,y,x,y.

scrollText.summary: Scrolling text configuration as comma-separated key=value pairs; direction, delays, repeat, stepSize and mode.

shadowColor.summary: Colour of the label text shadow.

shadowOffset.summary: x,y offset of the text shadow; scaled with the screen.

tabWidth.summary: Tab-stop width for supporting text widgets; auto uses the automatic width.

text.summary: Static text, translated before setText. Python or a renderer may replace it later.

textBorderColor.summary: Explicit colour of the outline around glyphs; different from a rectangle border.

underline.summary: Enable or disable underlined label text.

verticalAlignment.summary: Text alignment inside the widget: top, center/middle or bottom.

wrap.summary: Text overflow mode: wrap, noWrap or ellipsis; current parser also accepts numeric strings.

alphaBlend.summary: Enable native widget background/border alpha blending where supported; useful for overlaying translucent rectangles.

borderColor.summary: Generic border setter. On eLabel this currently changes the text outline; use widgetBorderColor for a rectangle border.

borderWidth.summary: Generic border width. On eLabel this currently changes glyph outlines; use widgetBorderWidth for the widget frame.

cornerRadius.summary: Corner radius, optionally followed by a semicolon and edge names, e.g. 24;topLeft,topRight.

transparent.summary: Boolean: suppress the widget background. This is distinct from the transparency byte in a painted colour.

widgetBorderColor.summary: Explicit rectangular widget-frame colour, including on eLabel.

widgetBorderWidth.summary: Explicit rectangular widget-frame thickness, scaled vertically.

alphaTest.summary: Pixmap transparency: off, on (alpha test), or blend (smooth alpha blending).

backgroundPixmap.summary: Background image for a native target implementing setBackgroundPixmap; not universal to all widgets.

errorCorrection.summary: QR code recovery level: low, medium, quartile or high.

foregroundGradient.summary: Legacy dedicated slider-gradient attribute; prefer a gradient in foregroundColor.

gradientMode.summary: Slider gradient behaviour: legacy or explicit. Check the receiver version before using this newer option.

orientation.summary: Slider direction: orHorizontal/orLeftToRight, orRightToLeft, orVertical/orTopToBottom, orBottomToTop.

overScan.summary: Pass the overscan value to a native target implementing setOverscan; this is not global TV calibration.

pixmap.summary: Resolved image path passed to LoadPixmap; PNG transparency is commonly used.

pointer.summary: Pointer image and anchor offset for supporting widgets; see the source setter for the colon-separated path/coordinate syntax.

quietZone.summary: QR code quiet-zone size; does not add general-purpose label padding.

scale.summary: Pixmap scaling flags, for example none, scale, keepAspect or centerScaled. Not screen resolution scaling.

scaleFlags.summary: Temporary compatibility route to the pixmap scale flag parser; prefer scale.

seekPointer.summary: Secondary seek pointer image and anchor offset, for widgets that support it.

backgroundColorEven.summary: Solid colour for alternating even list rows; gradients are not accepted here.

backgroundColorOdd.summary: Solid base/odd-row list background; gradients are not accepted here.

backgroundColorSelected.summary: Selected row background, as solid colour or a gradient specification.

enableWrapAround.summary: Allow list navigation to wrap from the final entry to the first and back.

entryFont.summary: Font for configuration entry labels on native targets supporting it.

foregroundColorSelected.summary: Foreground/text colour for selected list entries.

headerFont.summary: Font for configuration/list headers on supporting targets.

itemAlignment.summary: Align list items within the available list rectangle; distinct from text alignment.

itemCornerRadius.summary: Rounded item background in its normal state.

itemCornerRadiusMarked.summary: Rounded background for a marked item.

itemCornerRadiusMarkedAndSelected.summary: Rounded background when the item is both marked and selected.

itemCornerRadiusSelected.summary: Rounded background of the selected item.

itemGradient.summary: Background gradient for a normal list item.

itemGradientMarked.summary: Background gradient for a marked item.

itemGradientMarkedAndSelected.summary: Background gradient for an item that is both marked and selected.

itemGradientSelected.summary: Background gradient for the selected list item.

itemHeight.summary: Height of one list entry, scaled vertically.

itemSpacing.summary: Horizontal and vertical gap between list items; one value applies to both axes.

itemWidth.summary: Width of one list item, scaled horizontally.

listOrientation.summary: List layout: vertical, horizontal or grid; not a slider direction.

scrollbarBackgroundColor.summary: Solid colour behind the scrollbar handle.

scrollbarBackgroundGradient.summary: Gradient behind the scrollbar handle on supporting targets.

scrollbarLength.summary: Scrollbar length: numeric value, full or auto; interpretation is the target widget's.

scrollbarMode.summary: Visibility and side of the scrollbar; showOnDemand, showAlways, showNever and side-specific modes.

scrollbarOffset.summary: Integer distance/offset passed to the native scrollbar; this handler does not apply screen scaling.

scrollbarRadius.summary: Rounded scrollbar corners, optionally restricted to named edges.

scrollbarScroll.summary: Scrollbar movement granularity: byPage or byLine.

secondFont.summary: Deprecated alias of valueFont for supporting configuration/list targets.

selection.summary: Enable or disable drawing the list selection highlight.

selectionPixmap.summary: Image used for the list selection background.

selectionZoom.summary: Selection enlargement as an integer percentage increment[,mode]: 25 means 1.25 times the normal size. The increment is capped at 500; see parseZoom for the mode.

separatorLineColor.summary: Colour of entry separators in supporting lists.

separatorLineSize.summary: Separator geometry: height, top,height or left,top,width,height; -1 has automatic/full-width meaning.

valueFont.summary: Font for configuration values on supporting targets.

alphatest.summary: Compatibility spelling for alphaTest. Use the canonical camel-case name in new examples.

backgroundGradient.summary: Deprecated dedicated gradient attribute; use a gradient value in backgroundColor.

backgroundGradientSelected.summary: Deprecated dedicated selected-row gradient attribute; use backgroundColorSelected.

secondfont.summary: Legacy spelling delegating to valueFont; use valueFont in new layouts.

selectionDisabled.summary: Legacy inverted selection switch; prefer selection="0" to disable highlighting.

sliderPixmap.summary: Deprecated alias of scrollbarForegroundPixmap; this is not the progress-bar foreground.

textOffset.summary: Deprecated route to padding via textPadding; prefer padding.

InitSkins.summary: Load emergency, subtitle, primary, display, optional skin parts and user overrides; configure desktop resolution and templates. Startup operation, not a per-widget helper.

loadSkin.summary: Read one XML skin and register its global resources and named screens. Returns True on a readable parsed skin, False otherwise; does not open a screen.

reloadSkins.summary: Reload global skin state and window styles. This is a broad application operation, not needed for opening an isolated example.

loadSkinTemplates.summary: Load component XML template definitions from the supplied filenames.

reloadSkinTemplates.summary: Rebuild component template definitions; clear=True resets previously registered definitions.

addCallback.summary: Register a callback to be notified when skin loading invokes its callback list.

removeCallback.summary: Remove a previously registered skin callback.

getParentSize.summary: Find a widget parent's size or use the desktop, for relative coordinate calculations.

skinError.summary: Write a skin error to the Enigma2 log; does not itself raise an exception.

attribDeprecationWarning.summary: Write a deprecated-attribute warning and its replacement to the log.

parseOptions.summary: Look up a string in an allowed-options dictionary; log and return the given default for an invalid value.

parseValuePair.summary: Parse a comma-separated x,y pair, with variables, axis-specific scaling and optional parent/widget dimensions. Returns a tuple.

parseAlphaTest.summary: Map off/on/blend to native pixmap alpha flags. Invalid input falls back to off.

parseAnimationMode.summary: Map window-animation strings to native show/hide flags.

parseBoolean.summary: Return True for 1, the supplied attribute name, enabled, on, true or yes (case-insensitive); other strings are False.

parseColor.summary: Resolve #AARRGGBB or a registered colour name to gRGB; invalid input logs and uses the specified fallback.

parseCoordinate.summary: Evaluate one design coordinate with scaling, center/c/e/percent and font-relative terms. Returns an integer, or None for the wildcard. It is not a CSS expression parser.

parseErrorCorrection.summary: Map QR recovery-level names to eQRCode constants; default medium.

parseFont.summary: Resolve face/alias and optional ;size to a gFont. Font size is scaled on the vertical axis; an unknown face falls back to Body.

parseFontScale.summary: Parse size;offset or width;offset into a scale mode and vertically scaled offset.

parseGradient.summary: Parse start[,middle],end,horizontal-or-vertical[,alphaBlend]; return three colours, direction and blending flag.

parseHorizontalAlignment.summary: Map left, center, right or block to native text alignment; invalid input defaults to left.

parseInteger.summary: Convert to int; log and return the supplied default on TypeError or ValueError.

parseItemAlignment.summary: Map item alignment names to native listbox alignment constants.

parseListOrientation.summary: Map vertical/horizontal/grid to listbox orientation bits; invalid input falls back to vertical.

parseOrientation.summary: Map slider direction names to orientation and reverse-direction flags.

parseParameter.summary: Convert a parameter token to string, colour integer, hex integer, float, named colour, font list or integer according to its prefix/content.

parsePixmap.summary: Load an existing resolved image path through LoadPixmap; strip a # suffix and log missing or unreadable files. Returns a pixmap or None.

parsePosition.summary: Parse an x,y pair and return an ePoint.

parseRadius.summary: Parse radius[;edge,edge] into a radius and corner bitmask. Plain radius applies to all corners.

parseScrollbarLength.summary: Parse a numeric length, full (0) or auto (-1), otherwise return the caller's default.

parseSize.summary: Parse a width,height pair and return an eSize.

parseTabWidth.summary: Parse a numeric tab width or auto (-1), otherwise return the caller's default.

parseScale.summary: Map pixmap scaling/alignment names to native blit flags; preserves numerous compatibility spellings.

parseScrollbarMode.summary: Map visibility/side names to native listbox scrollbar constants.

parseScrollbarScroll.summary: Map byPage/byLine to the native scrolling policy.

parseScrollText.summary: Parse comma-separated key=value text-scrolling options into direction, delays, repeat, step size and mode.

parseSeparator.summary: Expand 1/2/4 separator values into left,top,width,height; supports automatic -1 fields.

parsePadding.summary: Expand 1/2/4 integers into left,top,right,bottom. Two values become x,y,x,y; it is not CSS top/right order.

parseVerticalAlignment.summary: Map top, center/middle or bottom to native text alignment; invalid input defaults to center.

parseWrap.summary: Map ellipsis/noWrap/wrap to 2/0/1; otherwise parse an integer with fallback 1.

parseZoom.summary: Map a list selection zoom mode to native listbox constants.

collectAttributes.summary: Resolve XML attributes, filenames, position, size, fonts and layout context before applying them to native objects. Mutates the supplied attribute list.

applyAllAttributes.summary: Construct an AttributeParser for a native object and apply the collected name/value pairs.

loadSingleSkinData.summary: Process global skin data such as output, includes, colours, fonts, parameters, layouts, subtitle styles and window styles.

readSkin.summary: Choose a named or embedded screen, build its layout contexts, connect sources/converters/renderers and collect component attributes. Called by Screen.

findSkinScreen.summary: Return the first registered name found in a name or list of names, otherwise None.

findWidgets.summary: Return names of widgets/sources/addon connections from a registered screen, expanding named panels; this is an XML scan, not screen execution.

getcomponentTemplate.summary: Return the registered XML component template for component/name (spelling is case-sensitive).

getcomponentTemplateNames.summary: Return names of registered component templates for a component.

getScrollLabelStyle.summary: Return one stored ScrollLabel default by key, or None if absent.

getSkinFactor.summary: Return desktop height divided by 720. Deprecated for OpenATV; prefer the screen resolution attribute for new layouts.

applySkinFactor.summary: Legacy helper multiplying numeric arguments by getSkinFactor; returns an int for one argument or tuple for multiple arguments.

AttributeParser.summary: Dispatches collected XML attribute names to native GUI methods; it is a shared dispatcher, not a guarantee that every widget supports every attribute.

additionalWidget.summary: Internal holder for a decorative native widget and its skin attributes.

ComponentTemplates.summary: Stores and retrieves component XML templates and tracks changes.

SizeTuple.summary: Tuple adapter used for already-parsed coordinates while retaining string-like methods expected by skin code.

SkinContext.summary: Layout origin, available size, scale and font context; edge-docked children can consume available space.

SkinContextStack.summary: Layout context that places children without consuming the available parent rectangle.

SkinContextVertical.summary: Context for vertically arranged content and its remaining space.

SkinContextHorizontal.summary: Context for horizontally arranged content and its remaining space.

TemplateParser.summary: Internal parser for list/content XML templates. Listed for discovery; full list-template tutorials belong to a later chapter.

SkinError.summary: Skin-processing exception type whose message can include the configured skin context.
